mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for glass railing installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for glass railing installation depend on your local building codes and the specific scope of your project. For instance, in cities like San Francisco or Walnut Creek, any structural modification or new guardrail installation often requires a permit to ensure compliance with safety and structural standards. We can assist in identifying whether a permit is necessary for your specific installation and guide you through the initial steps of the application process, which is a crucial part of our service.
